newsitem.title: USA: Stelax Industries gets 3 yr contract.
newsitem.headline: Stelax Industries gets 3 yr contract.

text.p: Stelax Industries Ltd said on Thursday it entered a three-year, $25 million contract with ASA Alloys for Stelax's entire line of stainless steel products.

The value of this contract, which is renewable every three years, does not include the NUOVINOX line, which could increase the value of the contract when the slated production begins later this year, Stelax said.
NUOVINOX is a carbon steel which is cladded with stainless steel, Stelax said.
Most of Stelax's export capabilities have been committed for the remainder of the calendar years, the company said.
